name: Word count
code: await somnia.commands.register('somnia.word-count.run', async () => { const files = await somnia.project.listFiles(); const name = files.includes('index.html') ? 'index.html' : files[0]; const src = await somnia.project.readFile(name); const text = src.replace(/<style[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gi, ' ').replace(/<script[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi, ' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' '); const words = text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length; await somnia.ui.notify(name + ': ' + words + ' words'); });
